name: Ramesh Kannan Rajendran
title: Senior Software Engineer
profile: Senior Software Engineer with 13+ years of experience designing and building scalable, cloud-native distributed systems using .NET, Azure, and modern databases. Proven expertise in microservices architecture, legacy system modernization, and REST API development. Experienced in leading cross-functional engineering teams using Agile/Scrum methodologies, driving CI/CD adoption, and delivering SaaS products at scale. Demonstrated track record of reducing infrastructure costs, improving system performance, and aligning technical roadmaps with business objectives.

MS SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, Elasticsearch
JavaScript, AlpineJS, HTMX, Bootstrap, SCSS, jQuery, Syncfusion EJ2 Components
Microservices, Multi-tenant SaaS, Identity & Access Management (IAM), Event-driven Architecture, CQRS

highlights: Leveraged GitHub Copilot to accelerate development, reducing implementation effort by over 60%.
Implemented xUnit-based automated testing, integrated into the CI/CD pipeline, achieving 85% code coverage.
Led the migration of a legacy ASP.NET WebForms application to .NET 10, ensuring compliance with enterprise security policies and enabling zero-downtime deployments.
Deployed as a Senior Integration Engineer to support Chevron initiatives, contributing to application modernization and enterprise integration efforts.
Architected and led migration of .NET Framework applications to ASP.NET Core 3.1, enabling containerization via Docker and Kubernetes on Linux; subsequently upgraded to .NET 6.
Drove backend database migration from MS SQL to PostgreSQL across production SaaS environment, reducing database licensing and operational costs by 40%.
Designed and implemented multi-tenant SaaS architecture, transforming a single-tenant system to support 500+ tenants with isolated databases and dedicated storage per tenant.
Built automated tenant provisioning and lifecycle management system using ASP.NET Core REST APIs.
Integrated Stripe payment gateway for subscription billing, handling recurring payments, proration, and webhook-driven lifecycle events for thousands of active subscribers.
Developed an in-house Identity Provider Server supporting SSO across Dashboard Server and Report Server using OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect protocols.
Led redesign and revamp of the Dashboard UI in collaboration with UX designers, resulting in a measurable improvement in user satisfaction scores and onboarding time.
Streamlined documentation release pipeline using Git Flow, cutting release turnaround time by ~40% and reducing errors in the publishing process.
Optimized support ticket creation workflow by implementing persistent user preference storage using MS SQL, to reduce average ticket submission time.
Redesigned download page UI using LESS, and jQuery for Syncfusion.com, improving page load performance by ~30%.
